fusions.name: Shed Antler
fusions.desc: Throws a shed antler that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 6 tiles, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Startled Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out through a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 7 damage with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Caught in Lamplight
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2.5 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Flinch
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge roll that failed is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
